# Story 01 — Tasks & Reminders

## Prerequisites

- ASP.NET Core Identity + JWT auth already in place: `src/BackEnd/src/CustomerSupportCRM.API/Program.cs` (line 25 registers `ICurrentUserService`), `src/BackEnd/src/CustomerSupportCRM.API/Extensions/JwtAuthenticationExtensions.cs`.
- `BaseEntity` audit/soft-delete infrastructure in place: `src/BackEnd/src/CustomerSupportCRM.Domain/Common/BaseEntity.cs` and `src/BackEnd/src/CustomerSupportCRM.Infrastructure/Persistence/Interceptors/AuditableEntitySaveChangesInterceptor.cs`.
- Front-end auth/routing scaffolding present: `src/FrontEnd/src/features/auth/`, `src/FrontEnd/src/routes/AppRouter.tsx`, `src/FrontEnd/src/routes/ProtectedRoute.tsx`.
- No prior stories in `.squad/plans/`; this is the first executable plan in the feature. Coordinate with owners of `sla-automation/system-notifications` — this story is deliberately scoped to **UI overdue indication only**, not push/email.

---

## Story Goal

Give the authenticated **Agent** a private per-user list of tasks/reminders they can create, view, edit, complete, and delete on their dashboard. Each task carries a **description** and a **due date/time (UTC)**. The agent sees only their own tasks. Tasks whose due time has passed and are not yet completed are visibly indicated as **overdue** on the dashboard.

Explicitly **out of scope**:

- Push / email / in-app system notifications when a task becomes due — belongs to `sla-automation/system-notifications`.
- Sharing tasks with other agents, assigning tasks to other users, or team-visible task boards.
- Linking a task to a specific ticket (kept optional-only: a nullable `TicketId` column is reserved but the ticket linkage flow is deferred until the Tickets aggregate lands).

## Product rules (from story)

- **Current behaviour:** No task/reminder concept exists in the codebase (Domain `Entities/` folder is a README placeholder; `Application/Features/Agents/README.md` is a placeholder).
- **New behaviour:**
  1. Agent creates a task with `Description` (required, ≤ 1000 chars) and `DueAt` (required, UTC `DateTime`).
  2. Agent lists their own tasks; other agents' tasks are never returned.
  3. Agent marks a task complete/incomplete, edits description/due date, or deletes it (soft-delete via `BaseEntity.IsDeleted`).
  4. A task is **overdue** when `IsCompleted == false && DueAt < now (UTC)`. The API returns an `IsOverdue` flag computed server-side; the UI additionally re-evaluates client-side for time drift after render.

### 1 — Domain entity

**Create file:** `src/BackEnd/src/CustomerSupportCRM.Domain/Entities/AgentTask.cs`

```csharp
namespace CustomerSupportCRM.Domain.Entities;

using CustomerSupportCRM.Domain.Common;

/// <summary>
/// A personal follow-up reminder owned by exactly one agent (Identity user).
/// Never shared. Scoped for read/write by <see cref="OwnerUserId"/> matching
/// <c>ICurrentUserService.UserId</c>.
/// </summary>
public class AgentTask : BaseEntity
{
    public Guid OwnerUserId { get; set; }
    public string Description { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public DateTime DueAt { get; set; }          // UTC
    public bool IsCompleted { get; set; }
    public DateTime? CompletedAt { get; set; }   // UTC
    public Guid? TicketId { get; set; }          // reserved; no FK yet (Tickets aggregate not implemented)
}
```

Do **not** add navigation properties to `ApplicationUser` — `OwnerUserId` is a plain `Guid` to keep Domain independent of Identity (mirrors the `CreatedBy` text convention in `BaseEntity.cs`).

### 5 — Application layer: DTOs, feature handlers, validators

Create the following under `src/BackEnd/src/CustomerSupportCRM.Application/Features/Agents/Tasks/` (mirroring the `Features/<Aggregate>/` layout implied by the placeholder READMEs in `Features/Agents/`, `Features/Tickets/`, `Features/Users/`, `Features/Customers/`):

- `Dtos/AgentTaskDto.cs`

```csharp
public record AgentTaskDto(
    Guid Id,
    string Description,
    DateTime DueAt,
    bool IsCompleted,
    DateTime? CompletedAt,
    bool IsOverdue,
    Guid? TicketId,
    DateTime CreatedAt,
    DateTime? UpdatedAt);
```

- `Dtos/CreateAgentTaskRequest.cs`, `Dtos/UpdateAgentTaskRequest.cs`

```csharp
public record CreateAgentTaskRequest(string Description, DateTime DueAt, Guid? TicketId);
public record UpdateAgentTaskRequest(string Description, DateTime DueAt, bool IsCompleted, Guid? TicketId);
```

- Service interface + implementation (a simple `IAgentTaskService`, injected into the controller — MediatR is not yet in the project; the `Common/Behaviors/README.md` placeholder confirms MediatR is deferred). Register in `src/BackEnd/src/CustomerSupportCRM.Application/DependencyInjection.cs`.

Service methods:

```csharp
Task<AgentTaskDto> CreateAsync(CreateAgentTaskRequest request, CancellationToken ct);
Task<IReadOnlyList<AgentTaskDto>> ListMineAsync(bool includeCompleted, CancellationToken ct);
Task<AgentTaskDto> UpdateAsync(Guid id, UpdateAgentTaskRequest request, CancellationToken ct);
Task DeleteAsync(Guid id, CancellationToken ct);
```

Rules enforced inside the service:

- Every method reads `ICurrentUserService.UserId`. If `null` or `IsAuthenticated == false`, throw `UnauthorizedException` (already defined in `src/BackEnd/src/CustomerSupportCRM.Domain/Exceptions/UnauthorizedException.cs`).
- `CreateAsync`: sets `OwnerUserId = currentUser.UserId!.Value`, `IsCompleted = false`, `CompletedAt = null`. Normalises `DueAt` to UTC (`DateTime.SpecifyKind` to `Utc` if `Unspecified`; convert if `Local`).
- `ListMineAsync`: `Repository<AgentTask>().Query().Where(t => t.OwnerUserId == currentUser.UserId)` (or equivalent); order by `DueAt` ascending; project to `AgentTaskDto` with `IsOverdue = !t.IsCompleted && t.DueAt < DateTime.UtcNow`.
- `UpdateAsync` / `DeleteAsync`: first load by `Id`, then check `OwnerUserId == currentUser.UserId`; on mismatch throw `ForbiddenAccessException` (already defined in `src/BackEnd/src/CustomerSupportCRM.Domain/Exceptions/ForbiddenAccessException.cs`). On not-found throw `NotFoundException`.
- `UpdateAsync`: if request flips `IsCompleted` from `false` → `true`, set `CompletedAt = DateTime.UtcNow`; if flipped back, set `CompletedAt = null`.
- `DeleteAsync`: soft-delete by setting `IsDeleted = true` and saving (soft-delete filter in `ApplicationDbContext` excludes it from future queries).

- FluentValidation validators for both request DTOs (see `Application/Validators/README.md`):
  - `Description`: `NotEmpty`, `MaximumLength(1000)`.
  - `DueAt`: `NotEmpty`. Emit a **warning-level rule** — do **not** reject past dates outright (agent may deliberately create a retro-active reminder). Simply document.

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Unauthenticated call:** `ICurrentUserService.UserId == null`. Service throws `UnauthorizedException`; middleware returns 401. Enforced in the service layer described in Backend §5.
- **Cross-agent access to a task:** `UpdateAsync` / `DeleteAsync` guard `OwnerUserId == currentUser.UserId`. On mismatch → `ForbiddenAccessException` (403). Do not return 404 in this case; the record exists, the caller is simply not the owner.
- **Task not found or soft-deleted:** repository query is filtered by `IsDeleted == false` via the global filter set in `ApplicationDbContext.ApplySoftDeleteQueryFilters` (lines 37–53). Missing id → `NotFoundException` (404).
- **Past due date at creation time:** allowed (agent may intentionally back-date a reminder). Validator does **not** reject it; UI shows the overdue chip immediately.
- **Time zone / kind mismatch:** always persist and compute in UTC. Service normalises `DueAt.Kind` before saving. Frontend sends ISO-8601 with `Z` suffix.
- **Long descriptions / Unicode (Arabic RTL):** 1000-char limit enforced by validator; column length matches config in Backend §2. UI uses MUI text field with `dir="auto"`.
- **Concurrent update from two tabs:** last-write-wins; no ETag/optimistic concurrency introduced (out of scope). Document in `AgentTask.cs` XML comment.
- **Soft-deleted task resurrection:** not supported by this story. Global soft-delete filter hides the row from all subsequent queries.
- **`TicketId` populated by client but Tickets aggregate not yet present:** stored as `Guid?` with **no FK constraint** — configuration must not add `.HasOne(...).WithMany(...)`. Add a `TODO` comment referencing a follow-up when the Tickets aggregate lands.
- **Overdue chip lag:** server computes `IsOverdue` once at query time; if the browser sits open for hours, the chip could go stale. Frontend recomputes locally in `TaskListItem` (see Frontend §1) as a defensive check.

## Migration / Rollback

- The migration only **adds** a table (`AgentTasks`) and its indexes. No schema changes to Identity tables.
- Rollback: `dotnet ef database update <PreviousMigrationName>` reverts. Because `AgentTasks` is standalone with no incoming FKs, dropping it is safe.
- Half-applied state (migration applied, code not yet deployed): the empty table is harmless. Reverse case (code deployed, migration missing) will fail on first query with a SQL error — mitigate by running migrations as part of the deploy pipeline before rolling out the new API.
